SRC-003:R0001.text: Provide one-click SEND AUDIT for the selected project, asynchronously reuse only a provably fresh ZIP or coalesce/reuse the canonical PackingService operation, then enqueue automatically.

SRC-003:R0002.text: Use the authenticated localhost Bridge as a pull-based broker; do not use SendKeys, clipboard, mouse/focus/HWND automation, Selenium, Playwright, DevTools remote debugging, external WebSockets, or native window titles as transport.

SRC-003:R0003.text: Maintain an ephemeral authoritative Widget worker registry with heartbeat TTL and accept at most six active browser workers; never create or dispatch to a seventh worker.

SRC-003:R0004.text: Combine heartbeat and atomic claim in bounded 15-25 second long polling with immediate wakeup for work, bounded exponential failure backoff, and best-effort offline release.

SRC-003:R0005.text: A Widget may report FREE only when ChatGPT is usable and authenticated with no generation, manual draft, attachments, active audit/start/action, unresolved START receipt, or other dispatch lease.

SRC-003:R0006.text: Keep dispatch_id strictly separate from the canonical campaign run_id; the existing audit engine remains the single campaign run-id owner and reports it after establishment.

SRC-003:R0007.text: Claim jobs atomically under a Bridge lock, issue unique leases, require dispatch_id/worker_id/lease_id for mutations and artifact access, reject stale or expired ownership, and preserve FIFO uniqueness and worker fairness.

SRC-003:R0008.text: Before START_PREPARED an expired lease may safely requeue; at or after START_PREPARED never reassign automatically, preserve the exact Widget START receipt and same-worker reconciliation so lost HTTP acknowledgements cannot duplicate Audit Core.

SRC-003:R0009.text: Stream the server-owned packed ZIP through an authenticated loopback artifact endpoint with ownership checks, safe filename, length/type headers, and missing/changed archive rejection; never accept a browser-supplied arbitrary path.

SRC-003:R0010.text: Reuse setNativeFileList and generalized attachment readiness verification, then invoke only startAuditCoreFromReadyAttachment and the existing START receipt/Auto lease/Auto3-SUPER10 machinery.

SRC-003:R0011.text: Schedule oldest queued jobs automatically when a safe worker becomes FREE, keep work queued while all six are busy, and distribute assignments deterministically without monitor/title coupling.

SRC-003:R0012.text: Persist a bounded human-readable JSON dispatch queue with atomic replace and mutation locking; reconcile restart states safely while keeping browser workers ephemeral and retaining bounded terminal history.

SRC-003:R0013.text: Expose compact truthful browser worker/job status to the Qt Project Room, including packing, queue, upload/start/auditing wave progress, completion/failure, and profile-derived wave counts.

SRC-003:R0014.text: Preserve /health, /v1/status, /v1/projects, /v1/audits, Bridge save queue, campaign persistence, and strict payload run_id versus CAMPAIGN_RUN_ID validation.

SRC-003:R0015.text: Keep browser dispatch domain/persistence/scheduling in browser_dispatch.py, HTTP adaptation in server.py, GUI facade in BridgeService, worker logic in Widget, thin action wiring in MainWindow, and packaging authority in PackingService.

SRC-003:R0016.text: All dispatch boundaries remain loopback-only and token-authenticated with strict bounded validation, project-registry-bound server-owned archive paths, no command execution, and no secret leakage into prompts or archives.

SRC-003:R0017.text: Pass deterministic Python domain, HTTP compatibility/security, Widget worker/attachment/START recovery, and local end-to-end lifecycle tests including six busy workers and one newly free worker claiming exactly one queued job.

SRC-003:R0018.text: Do not claim complete until the real Windows Brave/ChatGPT Widget transport is exercised: ZIP appears, reaches READY, canonical Audit Core starts once, busy workers remain untouched, and the worker safely returns FREE after terminal completion.
